products.name: Proof-of-Concept Kit — Microsoft Defender for Cloud — Commercial
products.short_description: Prove Microsoft Defender for Cloud in your own tenant — a guided proof-of-concept kit that stands up a scoped pilot and demonstrates cloud security posture & workload protection on real signal.
products.description:
Prove Microsoft Defender for Cloud in your own tenant — a guided proof-of-concept kit that stands up a scoped pilot and demonstrates cloud security posture & workload protection on real signal.

Deciding on Microsoft Defender for Cloud shouldn't rest on a slide deck. This PoC kit stands up a scoped, safe proof of concept in your tenant: enable the product on a pilot ring, generate benign test signal, and demonstrate the key detections/capabilities of cloud security posture & workload protection — with a scorecard and a clean teardown.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Scoped pilot enablement of Microsoft Defender for Cloud on a test ring
  • Benign test-signal / simulation to trigger key detections
  • Demonstration script for the headline capabilities
  • Success scorecard mapped to evaluation criteria
  • Clean teardown / rollback of the PoC

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A concrete, in-tenant proof that Microsoft Defender for Cloud delivers cloud security posture & workload protection — evaluated on real signal, scored against your criteria, and cleanly torn down.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • POCMDC-Enable.ps1 — pilot-scoped enable of Microsoft Defender for Cloud for a proof of concept. -WhatIf-gated
    • POCMDC-Scorecard.ps1 — score the Defender for Cloud proof of concept against your evaluation criteria. Read-only
    • POCMDC-Teardown.ps1 — clean rollback of the Defender for Cloud proof of concept (and STOP billing). -WhatIf-gated
    • POCMDC-TestSignal.ps1 — generate BENIGN, simulated cloud-security test signal for the MDC PoC. Safe only
    • POCMDC-Validate.ps1 — demo/validate that the benign test signal produced real Defender-for-Cloud detections. Read-only

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
